title: Opus 5.5 NBA 2K
shortDescription: Shoot, dribble and dunk in a 3D arena

gameplay_evidence: Hands-on keyboard input was accepted by the embedded basketball game: Space triggered the EARLY JUMP SHOT state, and the subsequent screenshot showed the live 3D arena/player/ball with the shot clock advanced from 24 to 22. This is gameplay response, not just a menu or HTTP result.

title: FlyCard

title: Mikage Quest

gameplay_evidence: The embedded game transitioned from its title menu to Hikari's bedroom, displayed Hikari Lv1 with HP 30 and MP 6, and advanced the dialogue through several different lines in response to Z input. A directional input then visibly changed the player sprite's pose/position. This confirms interactive game state beyond the title screen; no combat was independently verified.
